item1.reason: The patient says twice that putting the radio on made the voice less distracting while sorting thread and that they then finished, which supports easier, not harder.

evidence.quote: I put the radio on, and it was less distracting, so I finished sorting the thread.
When I was sorting the thread last week, it made the voice less distracting, and I finished sorting.

item2.reason: The patient reports the voice said “too slow” while they were sorting, and states it wasn’t telling them to do anything, so it was a comment rather than an instruction.

evidence.quote: while I was sorting my sewing supplies, I heard a voice say “too slow.”
It wasn’t telling me to do anything.
